_meta.status: SPEC ONLY - no data built, no values copied
_meta.purpose: Optional 'reported humanitarian situation' layer as an alternative to a war-control layer. It shows what humanitarian agencies report (displacement counts, access constraints) per admin unit and date, and makes no territorial-control claims.
rules: No fatality figures, even where a source carries them (OCHA access snapshots report aid-worker deaths; drop those fields).
No territorial-control fields or colouring by party.
Every feature must carry source_id, dataset date, retrieved date and licence.
